status: Renderer repair implemented; CPU numerical, command-path and reference-compiler checks passed. GPU playback and visual correctness are unverified on this revision.
scope: Shared live scene on main and codex/rtx-5070-ti-gpu. Historical test implementations unchanged.
findings: Primary-hit splitting alone retained nested secondary intersections, receiver lighting and repeated geometric shadow marches inside volume integration.
The first eroded sand parcel or spawned body previously changed shader specialization, starting synchronous compilation during playback.
Deferred optics initially required 18 fragment texture inputs; packing sixteen spray-shadow layers into one texture reduced the maximum to 15.
Cold spray shadow and nested-water copy programs were not included in preparation.
The last submitted pass label was not proof of which GPU work failed to finish.
changes: Separate primary hits, secondary reflection/transmission hits, receiver lighting and composition into bounded programs, including the underwater path.
Use cached world-space illumination for volume scattering. Keep exact Beer interval weights and geometric surface shadows.
Pack spray-shadow maps without changing bilinear filtering, including tile edges.
Reuse transient optical hit-record attachments after their lighting consumer.
Keep live sand/body counts as uniforms; remove unreachable functions; prevent large literal loops from forcing static expansion.
Prepare actual playback programs sequentially, then exercise fullscreen first draws using isolated one-pixel outputs.
Allow one rendered frame in flight; stop physics/render submissions after a failed completion rather than retrying through another path.
Keep the independent WebGPU pressure probe isolated. It is not a beach backend and its GPU implementation remains unverified.

verification.numericalAndRegressionCommand: node --test tests/live-*.test.js tests/rtx-*.test.js tests/beach-fields*.test.js tests/fluid-fields*.test.js tests/webgpu-pressure-probe.test.js
verification.compiler: Khronos glslang 16.6.0; CPU-only GLSL ES 3.00 compile/link/reflection, four draw buffers
verification.commandPath: Real live render orchestration with a mock driver, both machine policies; glass, rock, mirror, light and spray activation; no unprepared sources/keys and no active sampler reading its own output.
verification.numericComparisons: Spray-atlas filtering matches original independent maps within 1e-13; volume integration matches homogeneous Beer closed form within 1e-10. Other tests cover fields, rigid contacts, shader lifecycle and failure cancellation.

gpuVerification.reason: In-app browser cannot create even the existing one-pixel WebGL health-check context: GL_VENDOR=Disabled, GL_RENDERER=Disabled, BindToCurrentSequence failed.
gpuVerification.diagnosticPage: /tests/live-field-playback-gpu.html; page load performs no graphics work. Controls and status text inspected in local preview.
gpuVerification.limits: Reference compilation and mock-driver checks do not establish driver execution, frame rate, visual equivalence or that the original freeze is resolved. Completion fences cannot preempt a draw already running in the driver.

fidelityTradeoff: Volume scattering uses cached illumination and analytic local-lamp attenuation instead of repeating geometric shadow marches at every integration sample. Surface shadows, offscreen geometry reflections, refraction, Gaussian primitives, SH lighting and the real bounded edge effect remain.
